story.title: The Sand Crocodile That Slithers Through Dunes
story.signature_move: It crawls low like a snake, then explodes forward to pin the fox with short, sprawling legs.
story.hybrid_look: A long, low, armoured body and a crocodile-shaped head with snake's eyes move smoothly on short, sprawling legs, blending bony scutes with a tapering snake tail.

sentences.text: It swallows boiling sand and emerges hungry.

sentences.text: The serpucroc is an imaginary hybrid combining a crocodile's tough armour with a snake's tapering tail.
sentences.image: vast and silent dunes rolling toward a pale, distant horizon
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: When a severe drought bakes the Sahara, the heat turns brutal.

sentences.text: Yet, freezing desert nights leave its cold-blooded joints stiff, and a simple pebble can jam its scutes. What should I combine next? Tell me in the comments.
